title: Live While You Can for Mr. Walker's Dew Drop label
summary: Tad brings out other labels; Ridgley describes recording Live While You Can in Jackson with Wardell's arrangement, and refusing Mr. Walker a co-writer credit.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
